target.title: fix(web-search): align credential presence with usable providers
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Web-search credential presence detection mixed ordinary provider options with real credentials, and the later manifest-based credential scan could still treat policy-blocked web-search plugins as usable. That left the security/audit heuristic vulnerable to both false positives from disabled/denylisted/not-allowed plugins and false negatives around explicitly selected keyless providers.

## Why This Change Was Made

The detector now only counts direct or scoped `apiKey` values under `tools.web.search`, applies consistent SecretRef/env semantics, checks plugin `webSearch` credentials including `baseUrl`, and treats manifest-declared bundled providers with `requiresCredential: false` as configured when explicitly selected.

The manifest pass now also carries one policy scope through the candidate checks: `plugins.enabled === false`, `plugins.allow`, `plugins.deny`, and per-entry `enabled: false` remove blocked plugin/provider candidates before keyless, env-var, and raw config credentials can count. Raw plugin-entry credentials are not narrowed to the bundled origin, so configured external web-search plugins still count unless the plugin policy blocks them.

## User Impact

Security/audit and setup paths get fewer false positives from non-credential search options and policy-blocked web-search plugins, while preserving configured external plugin credentials and explicitly selected keyless web-search providers. No live provider key is needed for the regression proof.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/plugins/web-search-credential-presence.test.ts -- --reporter=verbose` (25 tests)
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check src/plugins/web-search-credential-presence.ts src/plugins/web-search-credential-presence.test.ts`
- `OPENCLAW_OXLINT_SKIP_PREPARE=1 node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs src/plugins/web-search-credential-presence.ts src/plugins/web-search-credential-presence.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --engine claude` clean, no accepted/actionable findings

## Proof

The focused matrix covers direct credentials, unresolved/resolved env SecretRefs, legacy env SecretRef strings, non-env SecretRefs, plugin `webSearch.apiKey`, plugin `webSearch.baseUrl`, external plugin entry credentials with bundled manifest records present, explicit keyless providers, explicit credentialed providers without keys, unknown providers, public artifact probe failures, allow-blocked keyless providers, denylisted manifest env credentials, globally disabled bundled and non-bundled providers, disabled plugin entries including canonical alias keys, ambient top-level keys when all known providers are blocked, shared provider ids where an allowed plugin still serves the provider, and the non-bundled empty-manifest fallback.
